pages.summary: Corrected hook samples to use generated event arguments and tightened scheduling instructions.
Corrected the clock distinction and client clock limits, clarified bed field types and namespace ownership, and removed worker-binding status language.
Kept the verified extinguish and silent-clear behavior while removing internal sound routing details.
Kept verified contextual emission rules and described native and wasm availability without boundary implementation detail.
Documented both registration Result types, error handling and screen behavior; removed roadmap language.
Clarified loop-replay playback flags and removed internal implementation commentary and the incorrect claim that no separate sound_play hook exists.
